description: NaGaSnP₂SO₁₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.46-2.65 Å. Ga is bonded to six O atoms to form GaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Ga-O bond distances ranging from 1.88-2.16 Å. Sn is bonded to six O atoms to form SnO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Sn-O bond distances ranging from 1.99-2.10 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent GaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent SnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 29-39°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.56 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent GaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent SnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 24-37°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.57 Å. S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent GaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent SnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 29-37°. There are two shorter (1.46 Å) and two longer (1.50 Å) S-O bond lengths. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ga and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sn, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sn, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sn, and one S atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ga, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ga, and one S atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ga, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Sn and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Sn and one S atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Sn and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ga and one P atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ga and one P atom.
